reasoning: The Bluetooth rune with three dots underneath clearly represents Bluetooth pairing or searching for wireless connections. It is a strong fit for tech troubleshooting and device pairing tasks, though many tasks mentioning 'Bluetooth' (like buying a Bluetooth speaker) are better served by the icon of the physical device itself.
